summary: iter113 REDESIGN — Frontend E2E + backend re-verification of pair-based VIP batches, client deposits, RBAC and revenue accounting. Ran main agent's backend smoke (manual_iter113_check.py): all core PASS except an accumulated-data absolute check (EUR inflow_vip_batches=210 vs =100 expected — expected drift from prior runs; delta is correct). Frontend: verified all new UI surfaces via Playwright with session_token cookies on preview URL.

minor.issue: Returns 422 but with message 'Para depositar USD usa: transfer.' — the 422 fires from a currency-method allow-list check BEFORE the courier-required check. Any currency where 'cash' isn't in configured methods will 422 with the wrong message rather than the courier validation error. Suggest adding an integration test using a currency whose config allows 'cash' (e.g. BRL) with USDT-eq > 1000 and no courier fields to prove the *courier* validator path actually returns 422. Main agent's smoke masks this.
